row.title: regen-generated needs the executor --fold flag on the top-level CLI
row.body: scripts/regen_generated.py calls 'foundation executor --fold --apply'; foundation/__main__.py declared its own executor sub-parser that did not know --fold, so regen-generated failed on every main push. A flag added to executor.main must also be added to the sub-parser in __main__.py.
